# Spec-derived SCP02/SCP03 transcripts with error status words between protected responses (seed 20261003).
# Card side: the independent reference scpref.py of the protocols review (GPCS v2.3.1 Appendix E,
# Amendment D v1.1.2), cross-checked command by command with the independent reference gp_ref.py of the
# audit; neither shares code with javacard-express. SCP02 with R-MAC: the card generates the R-MAC of an
# error over the stripped command, '00' and the status word and keeps it as the ICV of the next R-MAC
# (E.4.5), but answers the bare status word, as ISO/IEC 7816-4:2005 5.1.3 forbids a response data field
# with SW1 '64'-'6F' (cases with 'modelA' also contain one error answered with R-MAC || SW).
# SCP03: errors carry no R-MAC (Amendment D 6.2.5) and the encryption counter keeps counting (6.2.6).
# Format: see ScpTranscript.
